title: Open-source 3D route, kernel lineage, and peer-risk cross-check

method.evidenceRule: Public API/entity presence, raw carrier preservation, graph parsing, B-rep semantics, kernel validity, and native application acceptance are distinct. Peer reports and changelog fixes are risk prompts, not local defect evidence.

evidence.route: OCCT ACIS/DXF component availability and kernel lineage
evidence.observed: Official OCCT materials distinguish the standard public exchange distribution from Advanced/Commercial Components and list ACIS SAT/SAB and DXF exchange among commercial components.
evidence.planUse: Do not assume the open-source OCCT kernel installation supplies an ACIS reader. A licensed component may be used only as an optional named route, with component/build/license and settings recorded; OCCT-backed FreeCAD/CadQuery remains one kernel lineage, not independent-kernel corroboration.

evidence.observed: FreeCAD documents C++ and legacy DXF importer backends, identifies 3DFACE only in the legacy list, says embedded ACIS/SAT is unreadable, and imports DWG by converting to DXF before using the DXF importer.
evidence.planUse: Bind exact converter, output DXF hash/version, importer backend/options, and per-source entity outcomes. Converter success or aggregate imported-object count is not 3D semantic acceptance.

evidence.observed: The public entity inventory and ACIS inspection tooling expose modeler entity/raw payload handling; the documented drawing add-on has no 3D engine and does not render ACIS.
evidence.planUse: Use ezdxf only for pinned DXF syntax/carrier questions, not as a B-rep validity or solid-consumer oracle.

evidence.route: LibreDWG peer regressions and ACadSharp writer-loss report
evidence.observed: LibreDWG NEWS records a SubDMesh binary import fix, a DXF-export correction for the final 3DSOLID/REGION SAT block, and size-arithmetic hardening. ACadSharp issue #1195 reports silent 3DSOLID/REGION omission including solid-only blocks; it was not independently reproduced here.
evidence.planUse: Retain these as test-design prompts. Existing generated modeler-carrier and MESH tests are the fast local owners; ensure per-source identity/block membership and exact payload disposition, and add no duplicate fixture/test unless source audit finds an uncovered local path.

implementationReadiness: Keep PAR-07/S8's carrier, AcDs ownership, explicit geometry, ACIS semantics, and application outcomes separate.
Record kernel lineage and commercial component availability for any future external semantic route.
Map edits to existing focused generated test owners before adding tests or fixtures.
Continue local implementation without waiting for external qualification; record unavailable routes as NOT_RUN/DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and self-unblock.
limitations: No peer parser, FreeCAD, CADMPEG, or commercial OCCT component was run.
The ACadSharp issue is a report and not independent reproduction.
This review does not prove that no other independent open-source reader exists.
J256, J260, J268, J284, J293, and J295 remain DEFERRED_EXTERNAL and non-promoting.
